[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Minimum and maximum with few comparisons** [CF 730B · Minimum and Maximum](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/730/B){rating="1800"}

Finding the min and the max separately costs $2n - 3$ comparisons. But comparing two elements **with each other first** tells you which one can still be the minimum and which one can still be the maximum. Each pair then needs one comparison against the current min and one against the current max: 3 comparisons per 2 elements.

[Solved in full in @sec-pf-p5-minmax.]{.card-link}
